lede: What Korean and global players run in Guild Conquest (길드 토벌전), from DCInside, the official Naver cafe and crumb.gg. Every claim links its post.
caveat: Best runs with a lineup: 3T 045G (Season 5 #2, Melon Soda, no move speed) and 2T 204G (Season 6 forum best, Cherry). Season 6 top-10 teams unpublished. Before the 10-08 level-120 patch.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: Your gap is setup, not power. Cherry deck at 2.2G: median ≈700G, best 900G. At the 2T runs' 750×, 2.2G makes ≈1.65T.
changes: Get the sixth beam more often: Tiger Lily all skill haste; restart any run where Pomegranate misses 다발 3 by the HUD's 27 s mark.
Brightseeker to 10★: two more rune slots. The 1T 999G author runs 10★.
Keep Brightseeker's in-battle haste in the 40–50 band.
Reroll ATK% lines on Macaron and Skating Queen to skill amp; Milk keeps all ATK%. Re-check the ATK order in battle afterwards.
Scorpion Lv.40 is fine if she lands exactly 7th in ATK in battle.
Once carries hold 10–13M HP (posters' estimate), level fillers to just under the beam line so they outlive the 17 s wipe (the 2T 204G build).
